Package neqsim.process.fielddevelopment.hybrid

Class MolarFeedAdapter

java.lang.Object
neqsim.process.fielddevelopment.hybrid.MolarFeedAdapter
public final class MolarFeedAdapter extends Object
Turns the solved well rates of the hybrid production model into compositional NeqSim feeds: component molar rates instead of oil, gas and water volumes.

Two routes are supported. With a black-oil reservoir simulation the surface gas, stock-tank oil and water are recombined at the well's current oil rate, water cut and gas-oil ratio by a VfpFluidFactory on the oil basis (for example RecombinationFluidFactory with rate basis OIL, WCT and GOR), so a changing gas-oil ratio or water cut changes the composition. With a compositional simulation the state proxy carries the hydrocarbon wellstream composition and its moles per stock-tank oil volume, and the feed is built directly from them plus the produced water. The returned fluids carry their molar flow, so they can be used as the fluid of a NeqSim Stream that feeds a network or process model.

    • wellFeed

      public SystemInterface wellFeed(ReservoirStateModel state, double oilRateSm3PerDay, double waterRateSm3PerDay, double gasRateSm3PerDay, double gasLiftRateSm3PerDay)
      Builds a feed from a reservoir-state proxy and explicit surface rates.

      This overload lets the proxy provide composition to the canonical WellSystem and field-network path without constructing a HybridWell or a second gathering graph.

      Parameters:
      state - reservoir-state proxy at the current cumulative volumes
      oilRateSm3PerDay - stock-tank oil rate in Sm3/day
      waterRateSm3PerDay - produced-water rate in Sm3/day
      gasRateSm3PerDay - total produced-gas rate including gas lift in Sm3/day
      gasLiftRateSm3PerDay - gas-lift rate in Sm3/day
      Returns:
      fluid with composition and molar flow rate, or null when the oil rate is zero
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if state is null, a rate is negative or gas lift exceeds total gas
      IllegalStateException - if the adapter has no route for the state
